data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 1.3m (2013: strengthening GBP 2.9m) net of reinsurance was made from prior year reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports an aggregate prior-year reserve release of GBP 1.3m (net of reinsurance) for calendar year 2014. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 (the 2013 closing gross claims outstanding) were GBP 69.876m, so the net release equals approximately a 1.86% reduction of opening gross claims. The report does not disclose a gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure in the notes; the quantified movement is presented net of reinsurance in the Managing Agent's report. The movement is attributed to favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve release of GBP 1.3m (2013: strengthening GBP 2.9m) net of reinsurance
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken as gross 'Claims outstanding' closing 2013 balance (GBP 69,876k) from Balance Sheet (page 15). Prior year development: the report only discloses a NET prior-year reserve release of GBP 1.3m in the Managing Agent's report (page 21). No gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities column) was found in the notes; therefore the prior-year movement reported here is NET of reinsurance (fallback per guidance). No claims development triangle or per-LOB prior year movement table was found in the available pages.
